label: Marathons
description: Whole-session arcs from 5 to 30 minutes: slow builds, crucibles and long holds. For long scenes that settle in.

patterns.name: Marathon Jumpscare
patterns.description: 25 minutes of dead silence broken by random jumpscares.

patterns.name: Marathon Mixed
patterns.description: 30 minutes of everything: silence, hums, soft spikes and brutal jumpscares.

patterns.name: Marathon Tease
patterns.description: 20 minutes of gentle hum with occasional teasing spikes.

patterns.name: Marathon Build
patterns.description: 15 minutes of sustained hum building through escalating spikes.

patterns.name: Franken One
patterns.description: A 20-minute mashup: warm-up, tease, racing heart, milking, overload, climax, afterglow.

patterns.name: Shower Crucible
patterns.description: 30 minutes with a floor of 10 throughout, three phases, and a 6-minute climb to full.

patterns.name: Shower Hard
patterns.description: 15-minute hard push: high floor, spikes to full, last three minutes pinned.

patterns.name: Ear Floor
patterns.description: 9 minutes of steady low floor with occasional soft spikes. No dead air.

patterns.name: Ear Fuck
patterns.description: 11 minutes: steady floor with edging spikes. No dead air.

patterns.name: Ear Max
patterns.description: 11 minutes: high floor, full ceiling. Hard and present, no dead air.

patterns.name: Ear More
patterns.description: 16 minutes: high floor, full ceiling, relentless.

patterns.name: The Marathon
patterns.description: 20-minute build, sustain and finish arc with the air pump along for the ride.

patterns.name: The Crucible
patterns.description: 25 minutes of everything woven randomly: silence, hums, soft spikes, jumpscares.

patterns.name: The Long Hold
patterns.description: 30 minutes, no dead air: a humming floor with a light squeeze and spikes.

patterns.name: Gentle Waves
patterns.description: 10 minutes of smooth waves between 8 and 15. Never empty, never too much.
